out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. OBSERVED NO WRITTEN PROCEDURE FOR CLEANING UP DIARRHEA OR VOMITING.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH CLEAN-UP PROCEDURE. KEEP ONSITE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the CHLORINE (BLEACH) solution IN THE SANITIZER BUCKET was measured at >200ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of CHLORINE (BLEACH) solution at 50-200ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI: ADDED WATER TO SOLUTION UNTIL IT REACHED 150PPM. RE-EDUCATED FOOD CFM ON CHECKING CONCENTRATION OF SANITIZER.
